description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Balraman Vedusulam as Vice Chairman of the Soranathota P/S. and Elected Mr. Thanakarasa Srivengadesvaram as a member of the Chavakachcheri P/S.
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes for local authorities, including the declaration of elected officials to fill vacancies caused by appointments or deaths. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it concerns the electoral system and filling elected positions in local government.
